name: Jimdi Plastics Inc
old_description: Jimdi Plastics specializes in the injection molding process. Our experienced engineers work directly with your team and can help source the perfect material needed for your part. We provide complete support for secondary operations for the duration of the part, from the quote to obsolescence.
about:
Jimdi Plastics was founded in 1997 in Allendale, Michigan, after initially leasing a 6,000-square-foot facility in nearby Jenison. The privately owned company began by producing a proprietary flooring system for the agricultural industry before expanding into custom injection molding for other customers.

The company operates a 40,000-square-foot facility in Allendale housing 16 injection molding presses ranging from 110 to 1,100 tons, supported by a staff of 60. It runs low, medium, and high volumes daily across multiple materials, offering injection molding, insert molding, and over molding. Jimdi also manages tooling from engineering through tryout, maintains relationships with domestic and offshore tool shops, and provides engineering support for material selection. Secondary operations include automated and manual assembly cells, sonic welding, silk screening, pad printing, and laser etching.

Jimdi serves agriculture, automotive, consumer products, office furniture, and recreation markets.

The company attributes its growth to flexibility and on-time delivery of quality parts, emphasizing efficiency gains through secondary operations and complete support from quote to obsolescence.
